answer.says: The particularity of the individual is realized only in the satisfaction of need; I shall not allow the oil to obscure the universal truth of my appetite.
answer.thought: She speaks with the practical wisdom of the merchant, who knows that the body is the first state. I shall finish the samosa with the dignity befitting a philosopher, though my fingers are already suspect.
